topics.title: Introduction to Python: features, interpreter and execution modes

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the main features of Python such as being high level, open source, portable and case-sensitive.
Explain how an interpreter executes a program statement by statement, unlike a compiler.
Distinguish between the interactive mode and the script mode of the Python interpreter.
Recognise Python keywords as reserved words that cannot be used as identifiers.
Apply the rules for naming identifiers to decide whether a name is valid.
Explain implicit variable creation by assignment and the use of # comments.

topics.title: Everything is an object and Python data types

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that every Python value is an object with a unique identity returned by id().
Identify the numeric types int, float, complex and bool from given values.
Describe strings, lists, tuples, sets, None and dictionaries and how they are written.

topics.title: Mutable and immutable data types and choosing a data type

concepts.learning_objective: Classify data types as mutable or immutable and trace what happens when a variable is updated.
Choose a suitable data type (list, tuple, set or dictionary) for a given situation.
Evaluate arithmetic and augmented assignment operators including %, // and **.
Evaluate relational comparisons, including string comparison, and logical operators.
Use the identity operators is, is not and the membership operators in, not in.

topics.title: Expressions, precedence of operators and statements

concepts.learning_objective: Identify valid expressions and statements in Python.
Evaluate expressions using operator precedence and left-to-right evaluation.
Use input() and print() with its sep and end parameters, knowing that input() returns a string.
Apply explicit type conversion with int(), float() and str() and predict its result.
Explain implicit conversion (coercion) and type promotion from int to float.

topics.title: Debugging: syntax, logical and runtime errors

concepts.learning_objective: Define debugging as the process of identifying and removing errors from a program.
Distinguish syntax errors, logical errors and runtime errors with examples.
